law: Use ColorSync directly when your app needs to manage color itself; for example, a professional photo, print, or video app that builds custom transforms, or a tool that inspects and calibrates the profiles assigned to devices and displays.
Use ColorSync to match color across color spaces and to read, author, and embed the International Color Consortium (ICC) profiles that describe them.
